extensionDescription.message: Lets the Hitster Android app play songs in an open Amazon Music tab.

optionsSubtitle.message: Scan a Hitster card with your phone and play the song on Amazon Music in this browser.

bannerConnectedDetail.message: Version $1 is running and listens on port $2.

bannerErrorDetail.message: The add-on cannot reach its helper app. Firefox reports: $1

setupIntro.message: This add-on plays the songs of scanned Hitster cards in an open Amazon Music tab. A Firefox add-on cannot open a network port on its own, so it needs a small helper app on this computer.

setupArchitectureLi1.message: The Android app scans the QR code of a card and looks up the title and the artist of the song.

setupArchitectureLi2.message: The app sends title and artist to the helper app, which listens on your local network.

setupArchitectureLi3.message: The helper app passes the request to this add-on, which searches and plays the song in your Amazon Music tab.

setupSecurityNotice.message: The helper app accepts requests from your local network, but only with the secret token shown on this page after the setup. Do not share the token and use the setup only in networks you trust.

setupInstructions.message: Unpack the downloaded archive and run the installer:

setupInstallUnix.message: Open a terminal in the unpacked folder and run

setupPythonUnix.message: The helper app needs Python 3. If it is missing, install it first:

setupRestart.message: Restart Firefox after the installation. This page then shows the helper app's status.

setupSnapNotice.message: Firefox installed as a snap or flatpak runs in a sandbox, which may block native messaging. If the helper app is not found after the installation, try the Firefox package of Mozilla or your distribution instead.

androidIntro.message: The app finds this computer by itself. Only if that fails, enter one of these addresses and the token in the app under Manual setup.

confirmRegenerate.message: Create a new token? The Android app must be updated with the new token afterwards.

testAnswer.message: The helper app answered with HTTP $1: $2

amazonIntro.message: The add-on plays the songs in an Amazon Music tab of this browser. Open the web player, log in with your Amazon account and leave the tab open while you play.

amazonNoTabs.message: No Amazon Music tab is open yet.

qrIntro.message: Scan the code with the camera of your phone. Phone and computer must be in the same network.

qrStep1.message: Open the link that the camera shows.

qrStep3.message: Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps from this source.

qrStep4.message: Start the app. It finds this computer on its own, then confirm the request on this page.

qrNoApk.message: This build of the add-on has no Android app inside. Build the Android app and rebuild the add-on, see the README.

qrNetworkHint.message: If the phone cannot open the link, first check that it is in the same Wi-Fi as this computer. Mobile data and guest networks do not work. If that is fine, a firewall on this computer may block port 8765.

pairIntro.message: Allow only your own phone. A device that is allowed can start songs on this computer.

openAccessHelp.message: Every device in this network can then start songs on this computer, without the token. Use it only in a network you trust, like your home Wi-Fi.
